definitions.explanation: Tight-fitting stretchy pants or leg coverings, typically worn as casual wear, sportswear, or as a fashion layer under skirts and tunics.

examples.japanese: レギンス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧。
⟦ヨガ→ヨガ：04737_yoga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧レギンス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動く：00904_ugoku⟧やすい。
examples.english: Leggings are easy to move in for yoga.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{裏起毛|うらきもう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧レギンス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かくて→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧⟦{手放|てばな}せない→手放す：05338_tebanasu⟧。
examples.english: In winter, fleece-lined leggings are so warm I can't live without them.

notes:
From English "leggings." A common fashion and sportswear item in Japan. In Japanese fashion, レギンス are distinguished from ⟦タイツ→タイツ：04683_taitsu⟧ (tights), which cover the feet, whereas レギンス end at the ankle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- レギンス⟦パンツ→パンツ：01374_pantsu⟧ — leggings pants (thicker, worn as regular pants)
- {裏起毛|うらきもう}レギンス — fleece-lined leggings
- ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧レギンス — sports leggings
- レギンス⟦コーデ→コーデ：17567_koode⟧ — leggings outfit/coordination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦タイツ→タイツ：04683_taitsu⟧ — tights (cover the feet)
- スパッツ — spats (older Japanese term, now often means shorter leggings)
- ⟦ストッキング→ストッキング：04682_sutokkingu⟧ — stockings (sheer, formal)
